good_to_know: Adoration Room is open every day from 7am to 6pm; closed on Public Holidays.
Confession is available 30 minutes before to 10 minutes before weekend Masses.
Rosary is prayed Monday to Saturday at 6.15am and 5.30pm; on Sunday 30 minutes before Mass.
Divine Mercy is prayed on Wednesdays at 5pm in St Faustina Room.

events.title: PIETA Singapore: A support group for bereaved parents
events.text: A support group for bereaved parents. Inviting all parents who have lost a child to unite with us in faith to seek God's comfort, wisdom and hope. Next session will be via Zoom on Tue, 24th Nov from 7:30pm to 9:15pm. Please email pieta.singapore@gmail.com for the Zoom link.

events.title: A Discussion Night for Young Adults on Artificial Intelligence through the Lens of the Catholic Faith
events.text: Join Caritas Young Adults for a night of discussion (with pizza and ice cream) as we pause to consider how we are using AI tools, their benefits, and their effects on our lives from the lens of faith. Sign up now at bit.ly/streetcreed or scan the QR code. For enquiries, please email Caritas Singapor

events.title: SVDP Migrant Talk: Fruit of the Spirit: 'Faithfulness and Self-Control'
events.text: All are welcome. Scan the QR code to register.

events.title: GO DEEPER – from the mind to the heart: Evening Talk
events.text: Join Fr Laurence Freeman OSB, and discover how Christian meditation can bring the peace of Christ in today’s chaotic and confusing world. Organised by World Community for Christian Meditation (Singapore). For more details and registration, please scan the QR code. Enquiries: email wccmsingaporenews@
